description: Use this when you are on a discovery call with a prospect and need to run the Blank Spreadsheet Close, or when the prospect has told you what they need their system to do and what it is worth monthly. Takes the prospect's OWN words as rows and organizes them into a Feature / Priority / Would Pay sheet, then returns the next question to ask and, once the sheet is quantified, the close script. Do NOT fill in features the prospect did not state, do not assign priorities they did not give, and do not invent dollar amounts — the entire mechanism depends on the prospect filling in this themselves. Use this only when prospect-stated rows are available.

hasBudgetAuthority.description: True if the prospect has confirmed they can sign off on spend.

rows.description: The rows the prospect has actually filled in.

feature.description: The capability, in the prospect's own words. Do not paraphrase into consultant language.

priority.description: 1-10 importance, as the prospect stated it.

verbatim.description: Optional exact phrasing the prospect used, for the pitch later.

wouldPay.description: Monthly value the prospect stated. Leave null if they have not said a number yet — do not estimate one.

name: growth.build_blank_spreadsheet
title: Build Blank Spreadsheet Close
